Staff Door.desc: Staff Doors block Guests but allow Staff through.
17_toolstation.desc: The Tool Station provides a toolkit that your staff can use to fix broken down equipment. Note: each Tool Station only comes with a single toolkit, so you'll need more than one if you want two staff to be able to fix things simultaneously.
64_broom_box.desc: The Broom Stand provides a broom that your staff can use to sweep litter from the floor.
65_sponge_box.desc: The Sponge Sink provides a sponge that your staff can use to wash things that get dirty.
86_mic_headset_box.desc: The Mic Headset allows your staff to be heard over the din of the aquarium while giving talks. You'll also need a Podium.
podium.desc: The Podium gives your Staff a place to stand while they give informative and entertaining talks to your Guests. They'll also need a Mic Headset.
